Back to Music

Remnant

Album · Artan Davoodi

A reconstruction of memory. Eight chapters return to what remained, rebuilt through the musician I have become.

Tracks8

StatusUpcoming

Story

Remnant returns to a formative period in Denmark: compositions, performances, people and unfinished thoughts. It preserves what survived without reproducing the past.

The project began with the private, unreleased Danish Expression of a Hijacked Plan, made in FL Studio. Remnant reconstructs that material in Logic Pro through memory, surviving music and a present perspective.

Repetition becomes self-confrontation, questioning, distance, love and confession. Still closes the album with what remains.

Related work

A standalone live acoustic recording of Still is already available. It is a separate master from the forthcoming Remnant studio recording.

Musical details

Intimate singer-songwriter, alternative, neoclassical, ambient and cinematic textures. Each track holds its own place within that space.

Production

Restrained arrangements bring acoustic guitar, felt piano and close vocals into focus. Silence, decay and audible imperfections remain part of the music. Reconstruction and production take place in Logic Pro.

  6. Lullaby
    Story

    Lullaby began before I met Filippa. After falling in love with her, it became an unspoken love song. I performed it while she was present, without telling her what it had come to mean. Within Remnant, it is for her: the last memory before distance.

    Lyrics

    Life is simple enough to make us fall in love. Diamonds shining above, simple as we thought.

    If you're falling in love, dark is replaced by light. Mountains kneel on their knees, air feels good when you breathe.

  7. Filippa
    Story

    A new composition written in 2026. Filippa names the woman I loved but never directly told. Small moments survived: her smile, familiarity, anonymous notes and everything left unsaid. The resolution is not an imagined answer. It is finally speaking.

  8. Still
    Story

    Still looks back across years of distance and change. It asks what happened to the people involved and what survives after the original moment ends. Loved you becomes Love you.

    This forthcoming studio master is separate from Still (Live Acoustic), with piano and a broader album arrangement intended.
